notes.title: Bump+Smack is Live!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

I'm very excited to announce the initial release of Bump+Smack. For launch week, I'm offering 40% off!

That's 7 days that you can get it for cheap, but only for this week.

If you have any troubles with the game, leave me a message on the community boards or send me an email at support@bumpsmack.com.

For those outside of the US, translations were done with Google Translate which doesn't always get things right. If you see something in the game that just doesn't make sense or you know should be corrected, let me know and I'll make sure it gets updated and also that you get credited.

Unrelated, this is my first video game release and August 9th marks my 40th birthday. The only gift I ask is that anyone who buys the game or downloads the demo please leave feedback and let me know what can be improved.

Thanks again and have fun!

notes.title: Bump+Smack Release Date Announced
notes.content:
I'm in the final stages of testing and I'm pleased to announce that Bump+Smack will be released at midnight Eastern Daylight Time on August 9th (August 8th 9:00PM on the west coast of the United States). 

Download the demo, practice up, and get your score posted to the leaderboards. New leaderboards will be available on release day!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Bump+Smack Demo 1.1A
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

I'm pleased to announce that the Bump+Smack Demo has been updated to 1.1A. This version includes an options to tweak video settings and a scores panel to view the top 10 demo scores. 

I'm wrapping up development of the full version and moving into the testing phase so stay tuned for Bump+Smack to be released in either late July or early August!
